To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a novel combination of meta-learning and adversarial training to defend against physical-world adversarial patch and universal perturbations; (2) meta adversarial training requires only a small amount of additional computation compared to adversarial training; and (3) meta adversarial trained networks achieve state-of-the-art performance against universal patch attacks on image classification.

meta adversarial training is an effective defense against universal perturbation attacks, that it can be used to defend against both patch-based and pixel-based attacks, and that it is more effective at defending against pixel-based attacks than patch-based attacks.
